IMPORTANT LIMITS: This tool is limited to a maximum of 1000 builds per request for performance reasons. If your query would return more than 1000 results, you'll receive an error message with a direct API URL to access the complete dataset.
To get fewer, more targeted results:
- Use 'fromDate' and 'toDate' to narrow the time range
- Set 'maxBuilds' to a smaller number
- Use parameters like 'username', 'project', 'userTags', and/or 'buildOutcome' to further filter the results set","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"buildId":{"description":"Unique id of the Vendor build scan.     - 'dependencies': Dependency information and resolution details
    - 'build_performance': Build performance metrics (execution times, resource usage, network activity)
    - 'caching': Caching information (build cache performance, configuration cache). Note: Cache performance data is automatically trimmed to show only the slowest 100 task executions per build to manage response size.

    - 'test_performance': Test performance metrics
